title: Preserve numbered notation per staff
scope: Retain the authored numbered-notation preference independently from standard, tab and slash notation.
acceptance: Use two staves with different numbered-notation flags and preserve their ownership.
Read and write the appropriate GP8 part settings without changing tuning or note values.
Pinned AlphaTab sees the edited numbered-notation state and the existing display flags remain independent.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce via the public Go parser and GP8 exporter, then load original and output with pinned AlphaTab. The observed end-to-end difference alone does not locate the failing stage.
